kcfe01.title: Here for the snacks (and maybe love)
kcfe01.caption:
Taurus walked into the confessional for the crackers and walked out with a crush.
Who else showed up for the food and stayed for the person?

kcfe02.title: Aries waited four whole minutes
kcfe02.caption: Four minutes without a reply and Aries came through the curtain. One text back and suddenly the most patient sign alive. Tag your four-minute friend.

kcfe03.title: Gemini booked the booth twice
kcfe03.caption:
One Gemini is so over them. The other one kept the napkin. Turns out both of them like them, which is a first.
Which side of you is winning today?

kcfe04.title: Cancer still has the hoodie
kcfe04.caption: It's not a hoodie, it's a whole museum with plaques. Cancer misses who they were in it, and folds it into the give-back box anyway. What's in your ex museum?

kcfe05.title: Leo posted it for one viewer
kcfe05.caption:
The selfie was for nobody. The refreshing was for one person. Leo's new plan: skip the post, just say hi.
Be honest, who was your last story for?

kcfe06.title: Virgo brought a binder
kcfe06.caption: Three tabs, two appendices and a pressed flower, and the conclusion page is still blank. Virgo's answer was never going to be in the binder. Who needs to hear this?
